name: btc-5m-binary-fade-flow-sized
_hypothesis: The fade + flow signal, unchanged, with the risk block sized for the 4,600 bets a year it places. The second hypothesis (configs/fade-flow-5m.json) failed its fresh holdout on one clause: a 15% drawdown limit inherited from a config that bet 235 times a year tripped at 15.07% late in a year that was +62% before it, while the edge (+2.31%) and significance clauses passed by a wide margin. With a stake of s and N bets the typical drawdown of an even walk is about s x sqrt(N); at 0.25% and 4,600 bets that is 17%, so the limit sat on top of an ordinary year. This config stakes 0.10% of bankroll a bet, which puts the same 15% limit at about 2.3 times the typical drawdown -- a tripwire that means something is wrong. On the four years already seen it halted in none, with drawdowns of at most 6.4% and yearly results from -4.7% to +20.5%. Those years are all burned for this signal; nothing in them is evidence.
_decisions: Every value was chosen by the person building the strategy, one at a time, with the evidence and the run it came from recorded in DECISIONS.md. Decision 1: keep the fade gate and add order flow. Decision 2: taker_flow reads the bar's own share, faded (the last 1, 2 and 3 minutes before the open were measured and were weaker). Decisions 3 and 4, chosen together: a |z| floor of 2.0 and no volume floor. Decision 5: the z-score span stays one day. Decision 6: either gate may fire, a disagreement is refused (betting.mode weighted, allow_dissent false). Decision 7: the taker vote is flat (score_span 0); the conviction floor of 0.85 and every fade-gate value are the fade config's, unchanged. Decision 8: risk sizing, a stake of 0.10% of bankroll with the 15% drawdown limit kept (option b of a, b, c in DECISIONS.md), chosen on four sizings run over the four seen years. Every gate value, the wiring, the vote and the conviction floor are byte-for-byte the second hypothesis's.
_protocol: Fixed on 2026-09-13 BEFORE the fresh holdout -- the year ending 2022-09-13 -- was fetched or examined by anything in this repository. The years ending 2023-09-13 (the second hypothesis's holdout), 2024-09-13 (the development year), 2025-09-13 and 2026-09-13 are all seen and are reported after it for reference only. Pre-registered pass criterion, on the fresh holdout, at the bet level: the backtest's hit rate above the 52.00% break-even by at least +1.0%, significant at 2 standard errors, and no halt. Anything less fails. The holdout is touched once, and this file is not edited after that run.
_params_pinned: Every gate parameter is written out rather than inherited. Relative to configs/fade-flow-5m.json exactly one value differs: risk.max_stake_pct, 0.0025 to 0.001.
